Setting.Name: PublicFrontend::Module###PublicBWBTicketContext
Setting.Description: API JSON read-only de contexto de ticket para o Claude Mail MCP (Bearer).

Setting.Name: BWBTicketContext::BearerToken
Setting.Description: Token Bearer para PublicBWBTicketContext. Definir só no servidor (ZZZBWBTicketContext.pm), nunca no Git.

Setting.Name: BWBTicketContext::AllowedIPs
Setting.Description: Lista de IPs permitidos (vazio = qualquer IP com Bearer válido). Preferir o IP do VPS mcp-mail.bwb.pt.
